requiredFindings.title: The frozen checker-case set omits known TOML parser resource differences
requiredFindings.description: A2 requires the existing D15 cases with no invented case, but the product parse_toml has explicit recursion and one-million-node limits while the reference calls tomllib.loads without those product limits. Existing identity tests show a 128-deep array returning TomlError::RecursionLimit and a sub-4-MiB array returning NodeLimit. The current D15 cases do not exercise these differences. An otherwise usable Cargo carrier/provider can therefore produce a different reader/link disposition because of an unrelated nested field, despite passing every proposed vector.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Retain all bound checker cases as the baseline, but allow and require targeted parser differential controls. Specify how product parser resource failures relate to the reference and existing reader/provider dispositions, including unrelated fields, without silently changing the admitted grammar or inventing public refusal codes. Keep the exact JSON profile aligned on bytes, depth, integer range, duplicate keys, floats and Unicode.

requiredFindings.title: Output-only vectors discard the reference checker's access assertions
requiredFindings.description: B3-b0 check_case uses SpyContents and OBSERVED to enforce notRead and notObserved expectations, including the r1/r2 pruned-anchor fixes. A2 lists only member/refusal/declaration/link outcomes and byte-for-byte output equality. A core can query metadata or bytes below an anchor and discard the result while matching every listed output. B3-b2a's walker comparisons do not validate the new reader/placement core's observation calls.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Carry the checker cases' forbidden metadata/content-access assertions into the WorkspaceObservation test adapter and vector controls, including member SX-1, dependency/VCS/Cargo anchors, hidden glob repositories and visible enclosing boundaries. Require a mutation that performs a forbidden lookup/read without changing final outputs to fail. Exact internal call-order equality is unnecessary; preserve the forbidden-access constraints.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Keep reader and member ledger terms disjoint in the later bound
nonBlockingObservations.description: A2-3 says the member term now covers the readers' native observation, while unchanged plan section 4.2 already has a separate reader term payable at n=0. Carry the prior plan observation into B3-b3a: assign each native read/placement charge once and preserve the reader term at n=0. This is a cost-model clarification, not a reason to change the split or blind-run gates.
